name: ILW Thursday Night Ringside

date.source: The broadcast's own dateline ("Date: July 9, 1998") and its Usenet posting date.

evidence.source: The federation's own broadcast script, subject "-=(ILW)=- THuRSDaY NiGHT RiNGSiDe! p.1" through "(Part 3)" (9 July 1998)
evidence.note: The promotion's own first broadcast: interview segments previewing that Sunday's Survival card, one wrestled match, and a closing brawl involving most of the roster.

matches.note: ILW's first-ever match. Rick Stevens knocked Hammer Head out with a chair-assisted Tombstone, then pinned him with the Malicious Intent (forward Russian legsweep) after a run-in by Brandon Bailey and Shane Dallas backfired.
